discovery_notes: Wave 2 DLR 2023-2026 LE slice. 32/32 searches, all search_snippet. Sources mostly Disney Pins Blog and WDWNT; few official. Some weekly-roundup URLs were mapped to pins by matching the roundup month to the release date stated in the summary. Conflicts kept: Vault Set 2 price 58.99 vs 54.99; frame 150 vs 149.99; Dumbo WoA ordinal 10th vs 13th (13th source URL unconfirmed so not recorded). A WDWNT claim that all Vault pins are LE 4,000 was seen but not attributed to a specific URL, so omitted. Aurora mini jumbo LE 3,000 appears only on marketplace/trading sites (ignored). Gaps: 2024 Parades/This is My Home prices; 2023 Metal Magic series; Disneyland 70th $99.99 LE 1,000 jumbo (June 2025, AllEars) and Key to Disneyland set not recorded; Club 33 70th pins; Kingdom Hearts 2026 shared series. No suspicious/instructional content seen.
